info.name: Nexura Hub API
info.description:
Live backend: https://nexura-hub-backend.onrender.com

API prefix: /api/v1

**How to use**
1. Run folder `1. Auth — Login (all roles)` first. Each login saves its token.
2. Student requests use `{{student_token}}`, instructor `{{instructor_token}}`, admin `{{admin_token}}`.
3. Seed IDs are already filled (Reactive Accelerator course, modules, lessons).

| Role | Email | Password | Token var |
|---|---|---|---|
| admin | admin@nexurahub.com | password123 | admin_token |
| instructor | tapas@nexurahub.com | password123 | instructor_token |
| student | student@nexurahub.com | password123 | student_token |
| student | sadia@nexurahub.com | password123 | student2_token |

Coupons: NEXURA20 (20%), FLAT500 (৳500). Dummy payments only.
Admin cannot use chat (403).
